summary: First testing pass on DroZon Sprint 1 (auth + roles + drozon.html HUD). Backend pytest suite (30 tests) executed against public URL: 20/30 passed. Three critical/high backend bugs found. Frontend: login → dashboard → users admin → drozon.html HUD flows all functional for commander and observer roles; observer/users role-gate and observer-banner both work as spec'd.

critical.issue: Returns 422 for every valid payload with detail `body.data required`. Root cause: signature has extra `me: Optional[dict] = None` param — because `dict` is not a scalar type, FastAPI treats it as a second body field and expects the request wrapped as `{"data": {...}, "me": {...}}`. Fix: remove `me` param (it is never used). Breaks: public observer signup, commander-created pilots, commander-created commanders, UserAdmin.jsx create user form.

Returns 500 `ObjectId is not iterable / vars() has no __dict__`. Root cause: `await db.missions.insert_one(m)` mutates `m` by adding `_id: ObjectId`, then the same dict is returned. FastAPI/jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId. Same bug will affect `POST /api/auth/register` return payload (line 315-319 also returns the user dict after insert). Fix: `m.pop('_id', None)` before return, or build a fresh dict.

After 7 consecutive failed logins with the same email/IP the server never returns 429; all responses are 401. `record_failed` writes `locked_until` as tz-aware datetime; on retrieval Motor/BSON returns tz-naive, so the comparison `doc['locked_until'] > datetime.now(timezone.utc)` in `check_lockout` would raise TypeError silently in some paths — or the identifier key differs across requests (behind Kubernetes ingress `request.client.host` may vary or all requests share same host but per-container attempt state isn't persisted across pods). Needs main-agent RCA; suggest normalising datetime timezone on read and adding a broad `try/except` log inside check_lockout.

action_items: server.py:283 — remove the unused `me: Optional[dict] = None` parameter from `register()` so FastAPI parses only `data: RegisterIn` from the body.

server.py:407-421 (`create_mission`) — do `m.pop('_id', None)` after `insert_one` before returning, or build a separate response dict; apply same pattern to `register()` and any other endpoint that returns the post-insert dict.

server.py:189-206 — fix brute-force lockout: (a) normalise `doc['locked_until']` to UTC-aware (`if l.tzinfo is None: l = l.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`), (b) verify `request.client.host` is stable behind the ingress or key the lockout only by email/username, (c) add a log/warn when lockout kicks in for observability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py register endpoint has a dead `me: Optional[dict] = None` parameter that not only is unused but actively breaks the endpoint (FastAPI body dispatch).
Multiple mutating `insert_one(doc)` followed by `return doc` pattern — this repeatedly leaks Mongo's `ObjectId` back into responses. Should be a linted rule for this project.

server.py imports both `HTTPException` and re-raises via `except HTTPException: raise` inside register — good — but the outer `except Exception: raise HTTPException(401)` swallows original JWT errors making debugging harder.

CORS `allow_origins=os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',')` with `*` plus `allow_credentials=True` — many browsers (incl. Chrome) will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Currently it works because same-origin, but if a mobile/native client ever calls cross-origin, cookies would be dropped. Suggest explicit origin list in prod.
Cookies are `secure=False` — OK for preview HTTP but should be flipped when running behind HTTPS in prod (the preview URL is already HTTPS so this could be secure=True today).
app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+ — should use lifespan handler.
drozon.html is a 10,950-line single file — not scoped for testing here, but flagged for future modularisation.

rca of the issue.register_422: FastAPI parses parameters typed as Pydantic model OR non-scalar (dict/list) as body params. `me: Optional[dict] = None` therefore becomes a body field and, combined with `data: RegisterIn`, forces the request body to be `{data: {...}, me: {...}}` instead of the flat RegisterIn payload the clients send.
rca of the issue.missions_500: `await db.missions.insert_one(m)` mutates `m` in-place to add `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The same reference is returned by the handler → FastAPI's `jsonable_encoder` calls `vars()` on ObjectId and raises. Reproduction: any authenticated pilot/commander doing `POST /api/missions {name, mission_type}` gets 500.
rca of the issue.brute_force: Suspected timezone-mismatch or per-request IP variability behind the ingress. Repro: send 6-7 wrong-password requests to /api/auth/login with the same email — all return 401, never 429. Verified via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestBruteForce.
